text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 5xx / timeout rate observed on /v1/generate (region-us-west2). Alert threshold tripped at 23:12 UTC. Paging oncall-sre.
carlos: I got the pager — jumping in. can someone post the correlation id or a sample request id?
dana: putting a quick timeline here — spikes start ~23:10, error % climbs to ~18% by 23:12. Customer impact: ~120 failed requests in 3m window (non-retryable client 502/504).
alice: grabbing gateway logs now. sample correlation ids: r=cid-0a3f9, cid-9b2ee, cid-0c1d4
bob: from the gateway, I see a pattern: upstream returned 504 then gateway retried -> second attempt also timed out, then 502 returned to client. looks like amplified failures on retries.
oncall-ml: adding ML runtime traces for cid-0a3f9: runtime shows long KV cache miss on step `kv_lookup`, per-token latencies spike to 2.3s. attaching snippet below.
frontend_sre: quick note: traffic split to canary (10%) + main. Canary shows less failure rate — main region hosts more heavy batch jobs.
carlos: copy. can we temporarily disable gateway automatic retries for /v1/generate to stop amplification? that's the fastest mitigation.
dana: I'll flip retry policy to 0 for that route. doing it now.
incident-bot: Deploy started by dana. Change: route /v1/generate retries=0. CI: passed. Rollout to us-west2 beginning.
alice: confirmation: retries disabled. monitoring now.
bob: logs show immediate drop in duplicate upstream calls — but error rate still at ~8% (some upstream timeouts remain).
oncall-ml: hypothesis 1: model worker threads saturating under long KV misses with certain prompt shapes -> longer tail latencies. hypothesis 2: upstream connection pooling issue causing socket exhaustion under bursts. hypothesis 3: an autoscaler hiccup caused capacity shortfall.
carlos: good list. who can grab worker metrics (GPU util, queue depth) for the 23:08–23:15 window?
oncall-ml: running `kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n runtime --since=10m | grep cid-0a3f9 -A50` — attaching key lines.

```
2026-02-14T23:11:55Z runtime[worker-3]: request cid-0a3f9 received, seq_len=145
2026-02-14T23:11:56Z runtime[worker-3]: kv_lookup miss, waiting for fetch (fsync) 1200ms
2026-02-14T23:11:57Z runtime[worker-3]: token_gen loop start
2026-02-14T23:12:00Z runtime[worker-3]: token_gen step t=2300ms -> timeout-> upstream timeout
```

alice: GPU util (node-runtime-12) shows 92% at 23:10 and queue depth jumping to 18 pending requests. autoscaler did not add nodes until 23:14.
bob: autoscaler logs show a delayed scale-up due to insufficient pod readiness: `Error: pod init container timed out` — looks like some nodes were slow to join.
dana: timeline note: autoscaler triggered at 23:11, but new pods reported `ImagePullBackOff` for a short period due to registry rate limit. registry rate-limit spikes correlated with batch job deployments earlier.
carlos: okay mitigation steps going forward: 1) restart a subset of runtime pods to unblock stuck init containers (now) 2) keep retries disabled 3) raise autoscaler min for next 30m 4) collect full trace for a few sample cids and build RCA timeline doc.
oncall-ml: restarting 3 pods now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime -n runtime --selector=evacuate=true` (manual drain to avoid connection drops). doing in 2 waves.

alice: restarted wave-1. within 60s pending queues dropped from 18 -> 6 on restarted nodes.
bob: registry rate-limit cleared after ~90s; remaining pods came up. cluster now at expected capacity.
dana: error rate trending down to 1.7% after restarts + no retries.
carlos: good. collecting logs for correlation ids: cid-0a3f9, cid-9b2ee, cid-0c1d4. who will own building the in-incident RCA doc?
dana: I will own the RCA doc. creating draft now: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/1967771234-rca-draft (will fill timeline, evidence, mitigation, root cause hypotheses)
oncall-ml: quick ask: include ML perf histograms for seq_len 120–200, and KV cache hit rate charts. attaching export command: `curl -s \"https://metrics/api/query?series=kv_cache_hit&from=23:00&to=23:20\" > kv_hits.json`

alice: adding gateway logs and correlation id mapping into the doc. also exporting autoscaler events: `kubectl get events -n k8s-cluster --since=20m`.
bob: note for postmortem: package info — image tag runtime:v2.14.3. we should look at recent changes to init container script that may have increased image pull size.

carlos: customer comms: SRE to notify customers affected by throttling: sending short note to #customer-impact with initial ETA ~15m. @support please prepare to escalate any VIP tickets.
dana: P0 mitigations done, customer impact reduced. leaving retries disabled for 30 minutes while we monitor. I'll schedule a canary re-enable step after confirmed stability.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Status update: mitigation applied by dana. Error rate down. Next check at +10m.
alice: for RCA evidence, we need: (A) full request traces for the three cids, (B) node join timeline and imagepull logs, (C) registry metrics for rate-limit spike, (D) autoscaler decision logs.
oncall-ml: adding ML note: KV miss path latency correlated with certain prompt token distribution; preliminary suggestion: cache warming and smaller batch sizes for long-seq requests.

carlos: thanks all. handing off to dana for incident wrap & RCA draft. dana, please ping when doc has initial timeline + hypothesis list.
dana: will do. initial doc up and I've added a short TODO list. leaving thread for postmortem comments. :thumbsup:
